messages:
alex: Heads-up — master CI turned red right after the lockfile merge from #constraints. Failing tests in tests/session_fixture.py. Error shows two different versions of the same package installed (proto-lib 1.2.0 and 1.3.1) in the same venv during the build.

maria: ugh. can you paste the pip output?

alex: pasted: ```Collecting proto-lib==1.3.1
Installing collected packages: proto-lib-1.3.1
Successfully installed proto-lib-1.3.1
ERROR: proto-lib 1.2.0 already installed in ./.venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages (requested 1.3.1)``` ... then tests blow up with ImportError: API mismatch

sam: weird. Could be a transitive extra from pyproject extras? The lock merge changed optional extras ordering yesterday.

nina: @alex can you try a clean cache install? `pip cache purge && pip install -r requirements.txt`

alex: cleared cache, same failure. Running `pip list` inside CI artifact venv shows both versions present. Attaching the relevant pip freeze: ```proto-lib==1.2.0
proto-lib==1.3.1
other==0.9.0``` 

maria: that suggests wheel vs sdist of different names got installed. Maybe two packages provide same top-level module. Could be our constraints file allowed both.

sam: can you run `pip debug --verbose` in the CI image? also request a rerun with full reinstall (no cache) and no parallel jobs.

alex: kicked a rerun (CI job 672). Meanwhile trying bisect: `git bisect start HEAD~20 HEAD -- 'poetry.lock'` — will check which lockfile change introduced mismatch. If someone has quick eyes, the merge commit is 7f9a2b3 (PR #4123) — it merged constraints from infra and web.

nina: if bisect looks slow ping me, I can snapshot the docker image and poke deeper. Also add `--no-binary` to pip to force sdist? might reveal wheel conflict.

ci-bot: Build #672 started — macos-3.10 / tests/session_fixture.py

alex: update — bisect points to 7f9a2b3, but the PR itself didn't touch proto-lib. It bumped `shared-extras` that include `proto-lib>=1.2` and another optional package pinned 1.3. So transitive pin collision.

maria: action: revert the constraints entry in that PR (or add an upper bound) so lockfile regen keeps single version. Can we hotfix commit to unblock CI?

sam: +1. @alex can you open a small revert PR and run quick CI? I'll hold off merges.

alex: opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4210 — includes temporary pin `proto-lib==1.3.1` until we sort transitive extras.

nina: thanks. once CI is green we should add a lockfile check in CI to detect duplicate packages by top-level module name.

maria: filed issue #987 for long-term fix (dedupe-checker). We should also add a note in the PR template to double-check extras.

alex: CI passed on PR 4210, merging revert. main is green again. closing the bisect thread.

sam: thanks all :tada:

alex: follow-up: I'll add a small script to the infra repo to detect two installed distributions with same import name. Will upstream as RFC.
